title: A Month Without Meetings

pre.en: What will happen next with No-Meeting Wednesdays?
pre.zh: 「无会议星期三」接下来会怎样？
options: They will stop at the end of May.
The trial will go on, and there's a meeting about it on a Wednesday.
Every day will become a no-meeting day.

intro: 这是一期公司播客：全公司试了一个月「无会议星期三」。主持人先报数字，再引几个人的原话。读的时候留意介词后面的动词：instead of sitting、without checking、before getting、in favour of keeping，一律用 doing。

sentences.en: Hi, everyone, and welcome to this month's company podcast.
sentences.zh: 大家好，欢迎收听本月的公司播客。

sentences.en: So, in May, all forty of us tried something new: No-Meeting Wednesdays.
sentences.zh: 五月份，公司四十个人一起试了件新鲜事：「无会议星期三」。

sentences.en: For one day a week, instead of sitting in calls, everyone worked on a single task.
sentences.zh: 每周有一天，大家不开会，各自专心做一件事。

sentences.en: And they did it without checking messages every five minutes.
sentences.zh: 中间也不会每五分钟就去看一眼消息。

sentences.en: Well, the results are in.
sentences.zh: 好，结果出来了。

sentences.en: According to our survey after the trial, developers freed up three and a half hours a week on average.
sentences.zh: 根据试行结束后的调查，开发人员平均每周多出了三个半小时。

sentences.en: Most of them said they got more done on Wednesdays than on any other day.
sentences.zh: 大多数人说，星期三干的活比哪天都多。

sentences.en: Testers cut down on "quick calls" by half.
sentences.zh: 测试那边的「快速电话」少了一半。

sentences.en: Lots of you were happy to lose those calls where somebody's sound kept cutting out.
sentences.zh: 很多人也庆幸，终于不用再开那种有人声音老断断续续的会了。

sentences.en: Arjun, one of our backend developers in Bangalore, told us, "I'm good at focusing, but only when nobody's talking to me."
sentences.zh: 班加罗尔的后端开发 Arjun 跟我们说：「我专注力很强，前提是没人跟我说话。」

sentences.en: And one designer finally finished a project she'd started before Christmas.
sentences.zh: 还有一位设计师，终于做完了一个圣诞节前就开始的项目。

sentences.en: Seventy-eight per cent of staff are in favour of keeping it.
sentences.zh: 78% 的员工赞成继续搞下去。

sentences.en: Not everything went smoothly, though.
sentences.zh: 不过也不是事事顺利。

sentences.en: Rachel's team had to move a client meeting at short notice, and one feature went live a day late.
sentences.zh: Rachel 的团队临时改了一次客户会，还有一个功能晚了一天上线。

sentences.en: But as Rachel says, "Nobody's given up, and nobody's let the client down."
sentences.zh: 不过就像 Rachel 说的：「没人放弃，也没人让客户失望。」

sentences.en: "When something was urgent, people still gave each other a hand."
sentences.zh: 「真有急事的时候，大家照样互相搭把手。」

sentences.en: The main complaint came from Mia, a tester in her first month.
sentences.zh: 意见最大的是 Mia，一位刚来一个月的测试。

sentences.en: Instead of asking one question in a call, she had to write eleven messages before getting an answer.
sentences.zh: 本来开个会问一句就行，她却得发十一条消息才等来答复。

sentences.en: "I don't mind waiting," she said.
sentences.zh: 「我不介意等，」她说，

sentences.en: "I just want people to keep in touch."
sentences.zh: 「我只是希望大家别断了联系。」

sentences.en: So, the trial will continue in June.
sentences.zh: 所以，六月接着试。

sentences.en: To decide the details, the management team has booked a two-hour meeting.
sentences.zh: 为了敲定细节，管理层已经订了一个两小时的会。

sentences.en: For next Wednesday.
sentences.zh: 就在下周三。

cards.note: to spend time doing, making or improving something
as shown by a report, a study or what someone has said
cards.tip: 后面接消息来源（报告、调查、某人），不接自己：不说 according to me，要说 in my opinion。
cards.example: According to the weather app, it'll rain all weekend.

cards.note: do / carry out a survey 做调查；fill in a survey 填问卷。
on trial 在试行中；free trial 免费试用。另一个意思是「审判」。
to make time, money or space available for something else
cards.tip: 宾语可以放中间：free some time up；代词只能放中间：free it up。
cards.example: Deleting old photos freed up a lot of space on my phone.

cards.note: used to say what is usual when you look at many different amounts
cards.tip: 常放句首或句尾；介词是 on，不说 in average。
cards.example: On average, I get about fifty emails a day.

cards.zh: 干成更多的事；效率更高
cards.note: to finish more work in the same amount of time
cards.tip: get sth done 是「把事做完」；get more done、get a lot done 都很常用，比 be more productive 口语。
cards.example: I get more done in the morning than in the afternoon.

cards.note: to do, use or eat less of something
cards.tip: on 后面接要减少的东西；减少多少用 by：cut down on coffee by half。
cards.example: I'm trying to cut down on sugar.

cards.zh: （声音、信号）断断续续；突然中断
cards.note: if a sound or a machine cuts out, it suddenly stops working for a short time
cards.tip: 说的是通话里声音断断续续；kept cutting out 是「老是断」。
cards.example: Sorry, you're cutting out — could you say that again?

cards.note: 专注于什么用 on：focus on one task。名词也是 focus。
staff 指一个单位的全体员工，不加 s；说一个员工用 a member of staff。
to support an idea or a plan
cards.tip: of 是介词，后面接名词或 doing：in favour of keeping it。英式拼写 favour，美式 favor。
cards.example: Most of the team are in favour of a four-day week.

cards.note: with very little warning or time to prepare
cards.tip: 英式用 at，美式常说 on short notice；放在句尾。
cards.example: Thanks for joining the call at such short notice.

cards.note: if a product, website or system goes live, people can start using it
cards.tip: 主语是功能、网站、App；过去式 went live。
cards.example: The new checkout page goes live on Monday.

cards.note: to stop trying to do something because it is too difficult
to not do what someone trusted or expected you to do
an urgent email 急件；邮件标题常写 URGENT。
to help someone, especially with a practical job
to continue to talk or write to someone
the management 指公司里管事的那批人；manage 的名词形式。
